name: memova
description: Create a Personal Manual, use Knowledge V5, and manage reviewed Knowledge Entries.

interface.shortDescription: Create a Personal Manual and use private Memova workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for Personal Manual generation, bounded Knowledge V5 retrieval, reviewed first-class Knowledge Entry creation and revision, automation workflows, and selected-content import. Personal Manual generation reads only the one confirmed bounded source scope, keeps source history local, and automatically publishes the final manual as a Memova Note.
defaultPrompt: Search and use my Memova Knowledge V5.
Create or update a reviewed Knowledge Entry in Memova.
